"Lady" is a song recorded by American country music artist Brett Young.
It was released on April 30, 2020, as the lead single from his third studio album, Weekends Look a Little Different These Days, which was released on June 4, 2021.
The song was written by Young, along with Jon Nite and Ross Copperman.
